wish_topics.evidence_span: I would focus on addressing one of the deepest-rooted issues that affects humanity: inequality
inequalities of access to education, health care, political influence, and opportunities
ensure the mechanisms of society are designed from the ground up to be equitable
no one is left behind due to economic disparities
Universal Basic Income: A direct payment to every citizen sufficient to cover basic needs
Comprehensive Healthcare for All: Ensuring that everyone has access to high-quality, universal healthcare, reducing the burden of illness and health disparities
Equal and Accessible Education: Making education affordable and accessible to everyone
Environmental Sustainability: Implementing policies and technologies that ensure the continuation of life on Earth, addressing climate change and habitat loss
resources are managed sustainably for future generations
Political Participation: Ensuring equal political representation and participation for all, with systems in place that protect against corruption
Technology for Good: Focusing on the responsible and equitable development of technology to enhance human rights, equality, and safety
a more equitable and compassionate society for all
